description: The background sync and its pending report (spec §8): `hook __sync-background` – as the prompt hook starts it, SKILLETOR_PROJECT_DIR naming the project and winning over CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR – syncs, says nothing and leaves its report; the next prompt, from a subdirectory of the project's checkout with no project in its environment (the git top level is the project), hands it out once under UserPromptSubmit; the prompt after that is silent. checkInterval 0: no prompt starts a background sync of its own.
